bullets.text: Chennai experienced road cave-ins in Velachery and Kolathur due to pipeline damage and metro work, requiring ongoing traffic monitoring.
Police issued high alerts in Chennai and Thiruvallur districts due to Cyclone Murasu causing six-foot sea swells, prompting public safety advisories.
Chennai and Thiruvallur districts declared school holidays due to heavy rain forecasts, and the office should track official district updates.
Pelican birds resting on high-tension towers in the Pallikaranai marshland are dying from electrocution, and officials must examine preventive wiring measures.
The Tamil Nadu Traders Federation Youth Wing held an anti-drug awareness marathon in Besant Nagar to engage citizens against narcotics.
A motorcyclist died after a lorry collision near Polivakkam in Uthukottai, highlighting the need for increased road safety checks.
The long-pending 22-kilometer Padi to Thiruninravur six-lane road expansion remains a non-starter, contributing to severe traffic congestion on the highway.
Residents in Ayanampakkam protested against the construction of sewage drainage from apartment complexes violating rules in Thirumazhisai municipality.
Larsen and Toubro's Vyoma.AI started constructing a 52 MW AI data centre in Chennai to expand local digital infrastructure.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercluster in Chennai powered by advanced GPUs, aiming for significant capacity expansion by 2029.
Industry experts at a data centre summit projected that Chennai's data centre capacity will increase sevenfold, generating substantial revenue.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway to connect founders and investors.
